All builds and relevant test suites pass.

## Summary

Fixed `server/auth/store.go` so `UserAdd` and `UserChangePassword` reject blank passwords unless the account is explicitly `NoPassword` (passwordless):

- Added `isPasswordEmpty()`, which treats a password as blank both when no hash bytes were provided (covers `UserChangePassword`'s old-log path, which previously skipped hashing for a blank plaintext password and silently stored a zero-length password) and when the hash is a valid bcrypt hash of the empty string (covers `UserAdd`, which always bcrypt-hashes the password server-side — even a blank one — before it reaches the store, and covers any client sending a `HashedPassword` directly).
- This check lives in `server/auth/store.go`, the single point all write paths converge on after raft apply (`applierV3backend.UserAdd/UserChangePassword`), so it applies uniformly regardless of which client, SDK, or tool issued the request — not just `etcdctl`.
- Added a new `ErrPasswordEmpty` (`"auth: password is empty"`) distinct from `ErrUserNotFound`/`ErrUserAlreadyExist`/`ErrNoPasswordUser`, wired through to a new `codes.InvalidArgument` gRPC error (`ErrGRPCPasswordEmpty`, `"etcdserver: password is empty"`) via the existing `util.go`/`rpctypes` mapping pattern.
- Passwordless accounts (`Options.NoPassword = true`) are untouched — the check only runs inside the existing `!NoPassword` branches.
- Added `TestUserAddWithEmptyPassword` and `TestUserChangePasswordWithEmptyPassword` in `server/auth/store_test.go`, covering blank plaintext, an explicit hash of the empty string, and confirming passwordless accounts still work.

All existing auth, v3rpc, and rpctypes tests pass, and `go build ./...` is clean.
